settings.section1.title: Basics
settings.section1.subtitle: Required. Inke bina AI start bhi nahi kar sakta.
settings.name.label: Aapka naam / channel name
settings.handle.label: YouTube handle
settings.niche.label: Aapka niche / topic — specific rahein
settings.niche.placeholder: e.g. AI tools for content creators ('tech' sirf nahi)
settings.positioning.label: One-line positioning
settings.positioning.hint: Aap 10 words mein kaun hain. Example: "18 y/o building a 6-figure AI agency" ya "Ex-doctor teaching evidence-based fitness".
settings.positioning.placeholder: Ek chhota sentence jo aapko sum up kare
settings.language.label: Default output language
settings.language.hint: Titles, descriptions, timestamps, scripts, aur MultiPost ke liye use hota hai.
settings.tone.label: Default tone
settings.tone.hint: Aap apne videos mein kaise baat karte hain. Aap isko Script Writer mein per-script override kar sakte hain.
settings.section2.title: Aapki audience
settings.section2.subtitle: AI ko ye batana ki aap kisse baat kar rahe hain, aadhi jeet hai.
settings.targetAudience.label: Kaun log aapka content dekhte hain
settings.targetAudience.hint: Age, profession, goals. Example: "20-25 year old Indian college students learning AI/coding"
settings.targetAudience.placeholder: Specific rahein — age, wo kya karte hain, wo kya chahte hain
settings.audiencePainPoint.label: Unki sabse badi problem jo aap solve karte hain
settings.audiencePainPoint.hint: Wo ek problem jiske baare mein wo uthte hi sochte hain, aur aap address karte hain.
settings.audiencePainPoint.placeholder: e.g. "Unhe lagta hai wo AI se peeche chhoot rahe hain par har tutorial engineers ke liye hai"
settings.audienceLevel.label: Aapke niche mein unka skill level
settings.audienceTransformation.label: Dekhne ke baad wo kya banna chahte hain
settings.audienceTransformation.hint: Transformation. Example: 'Ek confident creator jo bina burnout ke weekly content ship karta hai.'
settings.audienceTransformation.placehol: Wo apne aap ka kaunsa version banna chahte hain
settings.section3.title: Visual identity
settings.section3.subtitle: Required taaki thumbnail prompts mein stock imagery ki jagah AAP aur aapke brand colors dikhein.
settings.appearance.label: On-camera appearance
settings.appearance.hint: Face, hair, aap kya pehente hain. Isse thumbnails asli mein aapki tarah dikhte hain.
settings.appearance.placeholder: e.g. Indian male in his 20s, short hair, usually wearing a black hoodie or casual t-shirt
settings.brandColors.hint: Brand colors — {color1} jaisa naam ya {hex1} jaisa hex code type karein, ya swatch par click karein.
settings.section4.title: Voice & tone — sharper scripts
settings.section4.subtitle: Optional, par yahan har field aapki scripts ko less generic banata hai.
settings.catchphrases.label: Catchphrases jo aap aksar use karte hain
settings.catchphrases.hint: Words/phrases jo audience aapke saath associate karti hai. Example: "Main samjhata hoon", "Bada idea ye hai", "Video ko yahin rokein".
settings.avoidWords.label: Words / topics jo aap KABHI use nahi karte
settings.avoidWords.hint: Aisi cheezein jo aapke brand ko todti hain. Example: "Avoid corporate jargon, no swearing, kabhi synergy word use mat karna"
settings.hookStyle.label: Aap usually video kaise START karte hain (hook style)
settings.hookStyle.hint: Examples: "Main hamesha sawal se shuru karta hoon", "Cold-open with the most shocking part", "Pehle stat, fir naam"
settings.ctaStyle.label: Aap usually video kaise END karte hain (CTA style)
settings.ctaStyle.hint: Examples: "Follow for more AI tools", "Save this for later", "Comment your biggest takeaway"
settings.contentPillars.label: Aapke content pillars (3-5 topics)
settings.contentPillars.hint: Main themes jinke baare mein aap post karte hain. AI ko brand-consistent rehne mein help karta hai.
settings.contentPillars.placeholder: e.g. "AI tools, freelancing income, creator burnout, productivity"
settings.preferredVideoLength.label: Preferred video length
settings.preferredVideoLength.hint: Aapki audience ke liye kaunsi duration best hai? Script Writer pacing optimize karega.
settings.section5.title: Advanced — fine-tune your voice
settings.section5.subtitle: Power-user fields. Sirf wahi bharein jo relevant ho.
settings.age.label: Aapki age (optional)
settings.whatMakesDifferent.label: Aap apne niche mein dusron se alag kaise hain
settings.whatMakesDifferent.hint: Koi AAPKO kyun follow kare vs 100 aur log jo wahi kar rahe hain.
settings.personalStory.label: Aapki personal story (background, journey)
settings.personalStory.hint: Journey, struggles, wins. Isse scripts mein relatability aati hai.
settings.credentials.label: Credentials / proof jo aap mention kar sakte hain
settings.credentials.hint: Followers, revenue, results, experience. Sirf tabhi use karein jab wo sach mein aapka ho.
settings.addressForm.label: Hindi/Hinglish address-form (तुम / आप)
settings.addressForm.hint: Aap audience ko Hindi videos mein kaise address karte hain. "Skip" agar sirf English output chahiye.
settings.usesSlang.label: Main slang use karta hoon
settings.usesMemes.label: Main memes reference karta hoon
settings.usesCursing.label: Main curse/swear karta hoon
settings.bestVideoHooks.label: Aapke 3 best-performing video hooks (opening copy-paste karein)
settings.bestVideoHooks.hint: Agar aapke past hits hain, toh pehli 2-3 lines yahan paste karein. AI study karega kya kaam kiya.
settings.bestVideoHooks.placeholder:
1. "I tried 5 AI tools so you don't have to..."
2. "Stop scrolling — is Notion template ne mere ₹20,000 bachaye..."
3. ...
settings.hookFormulas.label: Hook formulas jo aapke liye kaam karte hain
settings.hookFormulas.hint: Examples: "money saved", "before vs after", "the one thing nobody tells you about X", "I was wrong about Y".
